name: skills
description: The Utopia Studio's skill marketplace. Four modules — GTM, Product, Investments, and Founder Productivity — 253 skills for founders, fellows, and the funds team. Maintained by Karan Pinto.

plugins.name: utopia-gtm
plugins.description: Go-to-Market — seven sub-modules (Growth Strategy, Marketing & Comms, Sales Enablement, Customer Success, BD & Partnerships, GTM Engineering, IP Commercialisation). Positioning, outbound, signals, content, paid, RevOps, retention, and agent governance.

plugins.name: utopia-product
plugins.description: Product — discovery, PRDs, design, build, deploy, and product metrics. Everything to define and ship the product.

plugins.name: utopia-investments
plugins.description: Investments — due diligence, financial modeling, valuation, capital markets, fundraising decks, and quant pricing, plus the founder-side investor reading room. For funds team and fundraising.

plugins.name: utopia-founder-productivity
plugins.description: Founder Productivity — onboarding frameworks, legal docs, knowledge management, agents, and operator tools that don't fit GTM, Product, or Investments.

plugins.name: prview
plugins.description: PR preview videos (ui-walkthrough): a narrated before/after video of what a merged pull request changed in your web app, recorded from the real app and posted on the PR. Lives in its own repo, so it ships its own version.

plugins.name: utopia-os
plugins.description: UtopiaOS for Claude Code: when a session starts, Claude sees the work you approved with Cobi (installing a skill, a setup check) and does it on your first message, with no check-in to type. Needs UtopiaOS connected to Claude Code from the AI tools page.

plugins.name: utopia-os-channel
plugins.description: Pilot: work you approve with Cobi in UtopiaOS arrives in your open Claude Code session by itself. Uses Claude Code channels (research preview): start Claude with claude --dangerously-load-development-channels plugin:utopia-os-channel@skills. Install utopia-os too.
